command: SET NOCOUNT ON; SELECT SYSUTCDATETIME() AS observed_at_utc; SELECT COUNT(*) AS remaining_test_databases FROM sys.databases WHERE LEFT(name,43) = N'ApprovalFlowTest_20261028T035746Z-43798524_'; SELECT name FROM sys.databases WHERE LEFT(name,43) = N'ApprovalFlowTest_20261028T035746Z-43798524_'; IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sys.databases WHERE LEFT(name,43) = N'ApprovalFlowTest_20261028T035746Z-43798524_') THROW 51001, 'Test databases remain', 1;
